tasks.short: Inspect painted parts for blisters, streaks and runs, find the cause, correct settings or clean nozzles, and note flaws and fixes.

steps.what: Coating operator monitors painting operations to identify flaws such as blisters or streaks

loop.input: Camera images of each painted part at the line exit.
loop.output: Pass, flaw with flaw type, or unsure.
loop.check: Known good and flawed challenge parts run each shift; false rejects and escapes are tracked; unsure and flawed parts go to the operator.
loop.stop: If challenge parts fail, the camera is bypassed and the operator inspects every part.
loop.why_not_simpler: Blisters and streaks vary in shape and light; fixed thresholds miss them.

steps.what: Coating operator finds the cause in viscosity, pressure, temperature or humidity
Coating operator corrects their causes by adjusting settings or cleaning nozzles
Coating operator notes flaws and fixes in the shift book

tasks.design: A camera at the line exit sorts parts into pass, flaw type or unsure, and the operator checks flawed and unsure parts plus a sample of passes; challenge parts run every shift. Flaw counts are logged per type, and the operator picks the fix from a list on the line terminal ({OPS_SYSTEM}). Finding causes and correcting them stay with the operator; the camera is not part of any safety function.
tasks.previous_blocker: Every part was inspected by eye and flaws noted in a shift book.
tasks.enabler_now: Camera inspection can learn from a small set of good samples.
tasks.still_hard: New colours and gloss levels need the camera retrained.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing that orange peel on a humid day means the thinner ratio is off.
tasks.altitude: The operator checks flagged parts instead of every part.

reach.learn: Whether flaw counts by type shorten root-cause work.

evidence.claim: Schmitt + Meissner checks 100% of moulded light panels in line with Inspekto; about 95% of inspection is automated with payback under a year (vendor reference, no baseline).
Learning models that ensure safety functions of machinery need third-party assessment; this camera only sorts parts.
Line cameras that may capture staff need works council consent and a DPIA.

assumptions: Boundary: from painted parts to the flaw log; rework is outside.
Input contract: good and flawed samples chosen by the quality inspector; fallback is visual inspection of every part.
Finding causes and correcting do not change.
The camera faces parts, not people.
research_questions: How many flaws does the camera miss against the operator?

already_counted.description: Coating operator checks flagged and sampled parts.

incremental.description: Coating operator runs challenge parts each shift.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: New colours need retraining and full inspection at first.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read line gauges, watch the spray pattern and equipment, adjust settings and write hourly readings.

steps.what: Coating operator observes machine gauges for pressure, flow and temperature to detect deviations from standards
Coating operator watches the spray pattern and equipment operation
Coating operator makes adjustments as necessary
Coating operator writes gauge readings on the hourly sheet

tasks.design: Line sensors feed a dashboard ({OPS_SYSTEM}) with control charts and limits per product, which alarms when pressure, flow or temperature drifts and logs the readings, so the hourly sheet goes. Watching the spray pattern and adjusting stay with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Gauges were read by eye and written on an hourly sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: SPC software reads gauges and PLCs and raises alarms.
tasks.still_hard: Older guns and booths lack sensors.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing a spray fan start to split before any gauge moves.

reach.learn: Whether control charts cut paint use.

evidence.claim: Q-DAS O-QIS reads gauges, CMMs and PLCs and shows control charts and alarms.
Per-operator logs in shop-floor systems need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the running line to hourly readings; maintenance is outside.
Input contract: limits set by the process engineer; sensors on the line; fallback is the hourly sheet.
Watching and adjusting do not change.

incremental.description: Coating operator reports false alarms to the process engineer.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write paint batches, viscosity and settings on the batch form, record film thickness, fill in counts and downtime, hand forms to the office and check the form at shift end.

steps.what: Coating operator writes paint batch numbers, viscosity and settings on the batch form
Coating operator records film thickness measurements on specified forms
Coating operator fills in shift output and downtime
Coating operator takes paper forms to the office for typing
Coating operator checks the record is complete before the shift ends

tasks.design: Scanning the paint batch label and reading line settings fills the batch record in the production system ({OPS_SYSTEM}); the thickness gauge sends its readings there too. Output counts come from the line and the operator adds downtime reasons. The record flags missing fields before the shift ends, so no paper goes to the office.
tasks.previous_blocker: Everything was written on paper forms and typed in by office staff.
tasks.enabler_now: Gauges, labels and line controls can feed production records directly.
tasks.still_hard: Older gauges without a data link still need typing.
tasks.human_edge: Adding the note that explains why a batch behaved oddly.
tasks.altitude: The operator adds reasons and checks gaps instead of filling forms.

evidence.claim: Q-DAS O-QIS reads gauges and PLCs into SPC records with a link to quality management.
Per-operator logs in shop-floor systems need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the paint batch to the complete record; batch release is outside.
Input contract: batch labels from the paint supplier; gauge readings from the thickness gauge; downtime reasons set by the process engineer; fallback is paper forms.
Checking the record still needs a person.
The clerk's time is outside the operator's savings.

incremental.description: Coating operator enters values when a link fails.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Lines with older gauges save less.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The coating operator keeps finding causes and adjusting the line; inspecting every part by eye, hourly sheets and paper forms shrink.
skills_to_grow: Reviewing camera flags and control charts
role.ambitious_version: An operator who spends saved time preventing flaws instead of finding them.

job.title: Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
